rule_r8_proposal: A report qualifies for independent and blind mode when (a) its published text is open (publisher, author copy, NSF PAR, or a working paper whose main-table numbers equal the published values in the I4R rows) and (b) its analysis data is openly deposited outside openICPSR (Harvard Dataverse, Zenodo, OSF, GitHub, author site), fetchable, under 1 GB, even without code. Seeded mode needs the authors' scripts and is not applicable to a data-only deposit.
method: Crossref + OpenAlex for DOIs and OA locations; Harvard Dataverse search API (title, author keywords, DOI); Zenodo and OSF search (title, authors); GitHub repository search; AEA article pages for the replication-package DOI; candidate open texts fetched (PDF magic checked, PyMuPDF text) and every paired o_coeff_dbl / o_std_err_dbl searched at the database precision. Scripts kept outside the repository; User-Agent Retally-curation/0.1, rate-limited.
